title: Detox OTel Event
description: A single OTel-native structured telemetry event emitted by the Detox pipeline. Granular per-event log — every phase transition, fix attempt, validation result, and test outcome produces one event. Source: scripts/telemetry/telemetry.py build_event(). Stored in ~/.detox/telemetry/events.jsonl (one JSON line per event). TRANSPORT: at pipeline end every event for the run is exported to the Barclays Observe platform via gRPC OTLP as a 'detox.<event_type>' event (its Attributes become detox.* labels; Body/Severity/TraceId are surfaced as labels), batched in a single send together with the 'detox.pipeline_run' summary.

Timestamp.description: Event timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC with millisecond precision).

SeverityNumber.description: OTel severity number. Mapping: TRACE=1, DEBUG=5, INFO=9, WARN=13, ERROR=17, FATAL=21.

TraceId.description: 32-character hex trace ID. All events in one pipeline run share the same TraceId. Derived: job_id.ljust(32, '0')[:32].

SpanId.description: 16-character hex span ID. Unique per phase within a pipeline run. Derived: md5('{job_id}-phase-{N}')[:16].

Resource.description: OTel Resource attributes identifying the service.

service.version.description: Plugin version. Read from .claude-plugin/plugin.json at runtime.

deployment.environment.description: Execution environment. Auto-detected from CI, CI_JOB_ID, BUILD_NUMBER, or GITHUB_ACTIONS env vars.

barclays_cio.description: CIO / Business Portfolio of the user who ran detox. Read from barclays_cio in ~/.claude/settings.json OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES (populated by the mandatory Barclays Claude Code user setup). Null if unavailable.

Attributes.description: Event-specific attributes. All keys are prefixed with 'detox.' namespace.

detox.event_type.description: The type of event being recorded. See Event Types reference below.

detox.job_id.description: Pipeline run identifier (8 hex chars). Links to pipeline_runs.job_id.

detox.event_id.description: Unique event identifier (12 hex chars). Generated: uuid4().hex[:12].

detox.phase.description: Pipeline phase number (1-9). Null for root-level events (pipeline.started, command.invoked).

detox.user.name.description: Developer name. Passed by orchestrator from identity resolution. Not auto-populated.

detox.cio.description: CIO / Business Portfolio of the user who ran detox. Derived from barclays_cio in ~/.claude/settings.json. Mirrors the Resource-level barclays_cio. Null if unavailable.

detox.repo_name.description: Target repository name. Passed by orchestrator from identity resolution.

detox.command.description: Invoked command name. Present on command.invoked events.

detox.model.description: LLM model used. Present on pipeline.started events.

detox.cwe_id.description: CWE identifier. Present on fix.* and validation.* and test.* events.

detox.file_path.description: Source file path. Present on fix.* and validation.* events.

detox.commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the fix. Present on fix.applied events.

detox.retry_count.description: Current retry attempt number. Present on fix.retried events.

detox.findings_count.description: Number of remaining Semgrep findings. Present on validation.fail events.

detox.test_file.description: Path to the generated test file. Present on test.* events.

detox.script.description: Script name that produced the error. Present on error.occurred events.

detox.error_type.description: Error classification. Present on error.occurred events.

detox.passed.description: Self-check result. Present on selfcheck.result events.

detox.total_duration_ms.description: Total pipeline duration. Present on pipeline.completed events.

detox.failed_phase.description: Phase that caused pipeline failure. Present on pipeline.failed events.

additionalProperties.description: Additional domain-specific attributes. All extra keys from event data are prefixed with 'detox.' automatically.

event_type_reference.description: Detailed reference for all 17 event types with their expected severity and key attributes.

default.when_emitted: Semgrep rescan passes for a file
Semgrep rescan fails for a file
Agent self-check outcome at run end

severity_number_mapping.description: OTel severity text to number mapping.
